attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Lantern Accord is hosting a trade fair at Lantern Hill.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as if just happening, with no marker that it is old"},{"span":"The Reedmother's Children report the river is full and the fish are foolish.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the latest bulletin as if new"},{"span":"They have been quiet since a failed raid on Gladwater.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the latest bulletin, and states an ongoing status the briefing does not give"},{"span":"One assumes they enjoy their combination of flood and poor catch.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a flood and a poor catch, which contradicts the good fishing season"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"The only new item is a single bare sentence with no wry take.
